answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The falcon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the relic is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
